subject.title: exec auto-reviewer re-bills a fresh model completion for every byte-identical repeated exec

question: May OpenClaw reuse model-backed exec reviewer decisions for byte-identical requests, and what full input fields must define that per-run cache key?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but reusing an exec approval reviewer outcome changes when a later request bypasses a fresh model review, so cache lifetime and key shape need explicit security-boundary intent.

options.title: Approve Full-Input Per-Run Memo
options.body: Cache parsed reviewer decisions only inside the shared reviewer instance, keyed by the full reviewed input or prompt, without persisting or converting them to durable approvals.

options.title: Memoize Low-Risk Allows Only
options.body: Cache only low-risk allow-once results while leaving ask, timeout, and model-error decisions uncached for a narrower behavior change.

options.title: Keep Fresh Review Semantics
options.body: Accept the repeated model cost to preserve one-request-one-review semantics until maintainers have stronger security or billing evidence.

recommendation.title: Approve Full-Input Per-Run Memo
recommendation.body: Cache parsed reviewer decisions only inside the shared reviewer instance, keyed by the full reviewed input or prompt, without persisting or converting them to durable approvals.
